text: dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 是面向 DSH 的 CNB forge provider，接入合并请求与工作树面板。它把 CNB 合并请求信息映射到 DSH forge：展示状态、可合并性、检查和评审者，读取差异补丁与提交文件，并支持发布评审和合并。插件还能从 Git 远程地址或合并请求网址识别仓库与请求，供会话关联使用。适合在 CNB 上托管代码、希望在 DSH 中查看和处理合并请求的开发者。运行需 Node.js 22 以上，并使用 CNB CLI 登录凭据或 CNB_TOKEN。

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb connects CNB merge requests to the DSH forge panel. It shows status, checks, and reviewers; reads diffs and files; and supports reviews and merges. It also matches Git remotes and request URLs to sessions. Requires Node.js 22+ and CNB CLI credentials or CNB_TOKEN.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 的功能「合并请求状态」：面板读取 CNB 合并请求、提交状态和评审者信息，并整理成 DSH forge 快照。打开合并请求详情时还能获取完整检查列表。
dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 的功能「按分支查找」：通过 Git 仓库和当前分支查找对应的开放 CNB 合并请求，并返回匹配的请求供会话关联。
dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 的功能「查看差异与文件」：读取合并请求文件列表并拼装统一 diff，也可读取指定提交的文件文本，供 DSH 面板查看代码变更。
dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 的功能「提交评审与合并」：用户确认后可发布合并请求评审，或选择合并方式执行合并；提交前会重新核对请求的 head 提交。
dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 使用前须知：请求 CNB API 需要有效凭据；默认读取本机 ~/.cnb/token，也可用 CNB_TOKEN 环境变量提供令牌。
dsh-plugin-forge-cnb 使用前须知：CNB 无法通过此 API 取消 WIP/草稿状态，需到 CNB 网页修改标题；差异文件列表最多读取 300 项，超大合并请求的差异和增删统计可能不完整。

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · dsh-plugin-forge-cnb：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

CNB ([cnb.cool](https://cnb.cool)) provider for the DSH **forge registry**. It registers a
`ForgeProvider` with `ctx.forge`, so the change request and working tree panel can show CNB merge
requests: state, additions/deletions, mergeability, checks, reviewers, diff, file contents, review
publication, and merge.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · dsh-plugin-forge-cnb：This is a host-side bundle with **zero runtime dependencies**: global `fetch` and Node built-ins only,
Node.js >= 22. No client or DSH package change is needed — registering the provider is enough.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · What it adds：| contract method | CNB source |
|---|---|
| `repositoryFromRemote` / `changeRequestFromUrl` / `changeRequestUrl` | remote-URL and MR-URL parsing for `https`, `ssh://`, and scp-like remotes, nested groups (`a/b/c`), `.git` suffixes, ports; the two URL functions are exact inverses |
| `fetch` | `GET /{repo}/-/pulls/{n}` + `GET /{repo}/-/pulls/{n}/commit-statuses`, plus per-head-commit totals (`…/files`), head commit date (`…/git/commits/{sha}`), and cached repository merge settings |
| `fetchChecks` | the same reads, always with the complete check list (no 50-row polling cap) |
| `findByHead` | `GET /{repo}/-/pulls?state=open&page_size=100&page=N`, filtered client-side (CNB has no head-branch filter) |
| `diff` | `GET /{repo}/-/pulls/{n}/files`, assembled into one Git-style unified patch |
| `fileText` / `fileUrl` | `GET /{repo}/-/git/raw/{commit}/{path}` (falls back to the base64 contents endpoint on HTTP 413), and the `/-/blob/{commit}/{path}` web URL |
| `merge` | re-reads the MR, compares `head.sha` with the confirmed commit, then `PUT /{repo}/-/pulls/{n}/merge` with `merge_style`; never sends `force` |
| `markReady` | no API exists; re

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Install：This is a DSH bundle distributed from GitHub rather than npm. Clone it, then install the checked-out
directory as a bundle in your profile (for example with the Plugin Manager's install-bundle flow, or the
`plugin_manager` tool with `action: install_bundle`):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/genius-alray/dsh-plugin-forge-cnb
```

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Install：The bundle ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the provider row; you pick the bundle, not the
row. It needs Node.js >= 22 on the host and a valid `cnb login` session (`~/.cnb/token`, re-read whenever
the CLI refreshes it).

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Enable it：The bundle ships a Cordis patch, so enabling it in the profile is one entry:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: forge-cnb
      name: 'dsh-plugin-forge-cnb'
      config:

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Enable it：| config field | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hosts` | `['cnb.cool']` | web hosts this provider serves; repositories on other hosts are ignored |
| `tokenFile` | `~/.cnb/token` | CNB CLI credential file; `CNB_TOKEN` in the environment overrides it |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | deadline of one HTTP request, combined with the caller's cancellation |
| `maxPages` | `3` | pages of 100 open MRs `findByHead` reads per lookup |
dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Enable it：Nothing is written to any repository unless you explicitly merge or submit a review.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · How a merge request binds to a session：The forge session layer discovers a session's change request by running `git` in the session
checkout: it maps the checkout's remote to a repository (`repositoryFromRemote`) and then asks
`findByHead(repository, branch)` for open MRs whose **head** is the current branch. Pasting a CNB MR URL
into the session binds it directly (`changeRequestFromUrl`), and bindings are re-resolved through
`changeRequestUrl` → `changeRequestFromUrl`, which is why those two are exact inverses.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Credentials：Scopes used: `repo-pr:r` (MRs, statuses, files), `repo-code:r` (commit, raw file), `repo-manage:r`
(merge settings), `repo-pr:rw` (merge), `repo-notes:rw` (review). Missing scopes surface as HTTP 403
(`errcode 10023`) and are reported as `unavailable`/`failed` rather than crashing the panel.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Mapping decisions：- **`updatedAt`**: CNB's MR detail carries no timestamps. It is the head commit's committer date
  (`GET /{repo}/-/git/commits/{headSha}`), cached per commit; when that read fails it is the first time
  this head commit was observed (stable across polls, not the time of every poll).
- **`closedAt`**: always `null`. CNB exposes no `closed_at`/`merged_at` on merge requests at all.
- **`unresolvedThreads`**: always `0`. CNB has no resolved/unresolved flag on review comments anywhere in
  the API.
- **additions/deletions**: sum of the MR's changed files. CNB caps that list (see limitations), so a very
  large MR's totals can read low; there is no MR-level statistics endpoint.
- **mergeability**: `conflict`/`no-merge-base` (or `blocked_on` = `code_conflict`/`no_merge_base`) is
  `conflicting`; `mergeable`/`merging`/`merged` is `mergeable`; everything else is `unknown`.
- **mergeReady**: `state == open && !is_wip && !is_merged && mergeable_state == mergeable &&
  blocked_on == unblocked` — `mergeable_state` alone is not enough (a `mergeable` MR can still wait for
  review or CI).
- **reviewDecision**: `changes_requested` on any reviewer win

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Diff format：The panel parses `diff()` with jsdiff 9.0.0 (`parsePatch`), which resolves a file's path from
`diff --git` / `---` / `+++` headers and silently drops a section that has only hunks. CNB's
`/pulls/{n}/files` returns hunks only and reports the file **basename** in `filename`, so this provider:

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Diff format：This is covered by an offline unit test that parses the assembled patch with the real jsdiff copy when it
is discoverable and skips otherwise.

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Known limitations：- **WIP cannot be cleared through the API**: `is_wip` is read-only on CNB, so `markReady` always fails with
  a message asking the user to edit the title in the web UI. The provider never PATCHes the title.
- **The changed-file list is hard-capped at 300 entries** even though CNB documents it as unpaginated
  (a verified 490-file MR returns 300). `additions`/`deletions` and `diff()` therefore cover at most 300
  files for a very large MR; there is no truncation flag to expose and no workaround endpoint.
- **Rename origin is not recoverable** from the MR file list; a rename renders as a change of the new path
  (no `rename from` header) unless the payload happens to carry `previous_filename`. Only
  `GET /{repo}/-/git/compare/{base}...{head}` exposes it, and that endpoint shares the 300-file cap.
- **No close/merge timestamp** (see `closedAt`), so the panel cannot show when an MR was merged or closed.
- **Resolve state of review threads is unavailable** (see `unresolvedThreads`).
- **Merge refusal shape is unverified**: CNB documents `403` (`die.WebError`) but may answer `200` with

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Development：```bash
npm install        # dev dependency: jsdiff, the same parser the panel host uses
npm test           # 85 offline unit tests (fixtures + fake fetch); live test skipped
npm run check      # node --check on every source and test file
```

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Development：The unit tests never touch the network: they load the synthetic responses under `tests/fixtures/` and inject
a fake `fetch`. Two format tests parse the assembled patch with the panel's own jsdiff copy; they skip when
the dev dependency is not installed. Write paths (merge, review) are covered only by fake-fetch tests; this
package was never used to write to a real repository.

An optional read-only smoke test runs against any repository and merge request you can read:

dsh-plugin-forge-cnb README · Development：```bash
CNB_LIVE=1 CNB_LIVE_REPO=owner/repo CNB_LIVE_MR=12 node --test tests/live.test.js
```
